bosscue.ch10: {boss} breathes a burning grave-cone and rushes the line with a stunning charge — spread out, keep the tank in front
bosscue.ch11: {boss} throws a lance down the whole line and hides behind a shard guard — save your burst for when it drops
bosscue.ch12: {boss}'s pollen slows and poisons the field and she heals herself — step out of the cloud and bring burst
bosscue.ch13: {boss} sweeps a half-circle cleave in front of him and locks one hero in place for two seconds, and every few seconds he cleanses an ally of its controls — spread out of the cleave and burst him while the lock is down
bosscue.ch14: {boss} sets the ground alight with wildfire roots, then collapses it to stun — spread out and keep a cleanse
bosscue.ch15: {boss} hurls fireballs into your group and sets every hero burning at once — spread out and bring healing
